statusDetail: The audit environment was intercepted by a DataDome device-check interstitial. The rendered DOM contains only a full-viewport iframe titled “DataDome Device Check”, and desktop/mobile screenshots state “Access is temporarily restricted”; site content and representative routes could not be reached. No quality verdicts, findings, or score were produced.
